title: Add `pushStateObject` to get Turbolinks compatibility
body:
This PR aims to fix #985 and get Turbolinks compatibility by setting `pushStateObject: { turbolinks: true }`.

You may reproduce the problem described by @ThomasBush on http://www.welcometothejungle.co/companies : 
- Activate some filters/facets
- Click on whatever company
- Go back => NOK (it doesn't work until you reach back `/companies` in the history)

---

see:
- https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/985
- https://github.com/turbolinks/turbolinks-classic/issues/363#issuecomment-85626145

Hi! Thanks for the contribution.

I think I get the fix: instead of pushing "null" as the state of the history API, you want to push some default value needed by your app to work?

If that's it, then I will make it a proper generic non-turbolinks related option that other people could use (like instantsearch({getHistoryState: function() { return {turboLinks: true} }}).

What do you think?

Yep, I just need to specify `{turbolinks: true}` on the state object.

The idea of `pushStateObject` was to be generic, but if you do have a proper solution, I'll take it :)
